label: Now Developing
items: Sherwin Gatchalian was elected Senate president June 17 with 13 votes; Sara Duterte’s impeachment pre-trial opened June 18 ahead of a July 6 trial start.
Mindanao earthquake death toll reached 78 with 1.4M+ affected; China removed its floating platform from Bajo de Masinloc after Philippine protests.
PH-US forces completed a fourth West Philippine Sea maritime drill June 14–19 as Marcos called a special session targeting an anti-dynasty bill.
